title: Ten thousand days
logline: The garage, October 2026, the week before the editor: forty boxes, numbered on their lids, stacked against the long wall. The pup on Box 1. A caption: the count.

panels.composition: The garage from the door: the long wall stacked three high with cardboard boxes, each lid numbered in marker, 1 to 40, some sagging. Box 5's lid reads NONE OF IT RAN. The pup asleep on top of Box 1 at the near end. The drafting table beyond, the lamp on. One caption, low.
panels.caption: Ten thousand days.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a garage studio seen from its doorway with a long wall stacked three high with numbered cardboard boxes from one to forty in marker, one lid reading NONE OF IT RAN, a small three-legged dog asleep on the nearest box, a lit drafting table beyond, no other words
image.notes: Letter after: the numbers, NONE OF IT RAN, and the caption.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The count. The pup on Box 1.
